method: Exact enumeration plus independently reproduced seeded pseudorandom samples; no player-strength model.

scenarios.label: Flush draw
scenarios.target: At least one more heart: enough for a heart flush.
scenarios.caution: Making this flush does not rule out an opponent’s full house or four of a kind.

scenarios.label: Open-ended straight draw
scenarios.target: Any five or ten completes the current 6–7–8–9 sequence.
scenarios.caution: A straight-completing card may also complete an opponent’s flush or a higher straight.

scenarios.label: Gutshot straight draw
scenarios.target: Any six fills the inside gap in 5–7–8–9.
scenarios.caution: The two-card result below counts hitting a six. A ten and a jack can also make a different straight without a six.

scenarios.label: Pocket pair → at least three eights
scenarios.target: Either remaining eight makes a third eight; hitting both makes four.
scenarios.caution: This counts at least three eights, including full houses or quads, not the exclusive three-of-a-kind category.

scenarios.label: Two overcards · pair an ace or king
scenarios.target: Hit at least one remaining ace or king, pairing a hole-card rank.
scenarios.caution: Six nominal outs to this target. A pair of aces or kings need not beat an opponent; this is not an equity estimate.
